_comment: Protocol 1.1 signed receipt vectors. Verify with jwks.json. Regenerate with scripts/generate-vectors.mjs. receipts-1.0.json is the frozen 1.0 set.

vectors.name: stepup-transaction-approve
vectors.description: Biatec Chat step-up receipt; binding_message is the empty string.

vectors.name: direct-transaction-approve-domain-proven
vectors.description: Direct entry of a client with a proven domain; the client text is rendered and signed.

vectors.name: direct-transaction-approve-domain-unproven
vectors.description: A client without a proven domain: the raw text is never rendered, so the signed binding_message is empty.

vectors.name: stepup-limits-change-approve
vectors.description: biatec_limits_change; request_hash is SHA-256 of JCS(limitsRequestBody).

vectors.name: direct-transaction-deny
vectors.description: Explicit Deny before any code was typed, signed by the approval key.

vectors.name: stepup-transaction-code-failed
vectors.description: Third wrong code; does not count toward rule 10's denial counter.

vectors.name: stepup-two-transfers-approve
vectors.description: A group with two outgoing transfers: the card shows both and the total.

vectors.name: stepup-transfer-plus-trusted-application-approve
vectors.description: A transfer plus an application the user already trusted for this client: the value is the transfers' value.

vectors.name: stepup-untrusted-application-approve-remember
vectors.description: An application the user has not trusted makes the value unknown; approving with `remember` trusts it for this client from now on.

vectors.name: stepup-value-unknown-approve
vectors.description: An asset with no market price: the value is unknown, there is no fiat_value and the card says "Value unknown".

vectors.name: direct-transaction-deny-presence-key
vectors.description: A deny needs no biometric: it may be signed by the presence key, whose attestation says so.

vectors.name: stepup-approve-signed-by-presence-key-REFUSED
vectors.description: NEGATIVE: the signature and the attestation are valid, but an approve receipt must carry an attestation with biatec_key_use "approve". Verifiers MUST refuse it.
